name: Our Story
description: Chapter-based scroll storytelling with 5 chapters (2015-2025), each with title, images, text, and Framer Motion animations (fade-in, slide-up, zoom)
acceptanceCriteria: Each chapter has: year + event title, 3-5 images, 1-2 short text paragraphs
Scroll-triggered animations: fade-in, slide-up, zoom on images
prefers-reduced-motion support: animations disabled when preference set
Max 40 images total across all chapters
notes: Content is Vietnamese. Quality over quantity for images. Each section must have meaning.
